title: Warmly Baked Chinese Beef Skewers
description: A fermented, crispy Chinese dish featuring mixed beef cuts, salt-bake, and dash-friendly seasonings, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, brown sugar, fermented bean paste, garlic, and ginger.
Add the beef pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and spray with cooking spray.
Place the skewers on the baking sheet and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Bake the skewers for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
